text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no shell tool in this session, so none of the fixes have been run. I checked each one by reading it against the tests.

- `search.py`: the import pointed at a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`.
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the comment and the tests.
- `fees.py`: `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- `factory.py`: `sample_books` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- `books.py`: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm the whole suite passes.
